items.title: Gingerbread Riding a Rolling Pin
items.alt: Moustached gingerbread character with a red neckerchief riding a wooden rolling pin and raising one cookie arm.
items.description: Two green peppermint buttons sit below the spotted neckerchief, while one bent cookie leg hangs over the pin.

items.title: Gingerbread Reader with Heart-Shaped Head
items.alt: Heart-headed gingerbread character with striped round glasses reading a green book while seated on a thick red book.
items.description: A tiny red heart joins the icing hairline above the eyes, and a scalloped collar frames two red candy buttons.

items.title: Gingerbread Ballerina in a Snowflake Skirt
items.alt: Slender gingerbread ballerina in an aqua icing tutu balancing on one foot with both arms curved overhead.
items.description: White snowflake piping, pink sugar pearls and a small crown decorate the lifted dancing pose.

items.title: Gingerbread Standing in a Cocoa Mug
items.alt: Small gingerbread character in a red scarf standing in a cream cocoa mug decorated with holly and red icing waves.
items.description: The figure looks sideways with one raised eyebrow, surrounded by floating marshmallows on the cocoa surface.

items.title: Gingerbread Playing a Peppermint Drum
items.alt: Tall oval-headed gingerbread drummer in a blue beret playing a red-and-white peppermint drum with two sticks.
items.description: A striped shoulder strap supports the drum while one red-tipped stick rises above the laughing face.

items.title: Gingerbread Watering Peppermint Sprouts
items.alt: Kneeling gingerbread gardener in a green bonnet and yellow overalls watering peppermint-striped sprouts in a brown pot.
items.description: Small white flowers decorate the bonnet, watering can and overall pocket around the rounded cookie face.
